info.title: NakiLiveTranscode experimental control API
info.description: Current implemented API only. Linux, one active job. No authentication. This static document is not served by the application. URI matching is exact (query strings and trailing slashes are not supported). Media errors after acceptance appear in job state=failed, not in a later HTTP response. Unknown and duplicate configuration keys are rejected. Request limit 16384 bytes, header limit 8192 bytes, HTTP timeout 10s. Libevent framing/limit errors and allocation failures can return HTML instead of the application JSON error envelope. Future pipeline-design.md fields are not accepted. One H.264/HEVC input, 1..4 fixed logical outputs, H.264/VVC encoding; bounded AAC/MP3 copy with append-only late audio in FLV/TS, video-only MP4. Only watermark supports runtime component updates. No arbitrary output rebuild, audio transcoding, SCTE-35, HDR/ROI, timestamp repair or /v2/jobs. Current local source-bound evidence and unverified external gates: docs/validation-core-refactor.md. This document is a contract, not proof of deployment.

post.summary: Create or retry one normalized creation intent in the fixed service namespace
post.description: 202 follows worker ownership ACK. Retry the same operation_id after an uncertain 503 or connection loss. Identical normalized spec returns the original job before busy admission; conflicting intent returns 409. Finite in-memory retention, not durable acceptance. Request body limit: 16384 bytes. Retained identical intent is finite in-memory replay, not durable/exactly-once execution.

202.description: Initial worker ACK returns JobStatus; retained accepted creation retry returns OperationResult.

503.description: Unavailable/recovering or unconfirmed acceptance. A retained creation may return its operation projection; do not assume rejection or use a new ID.

post.description: Reserve one stop operation per job. Duplicate accepted operation replays before current-job admission checks. 202 follows worker stop-intent ACK; query state separately. New stale-target stop cannot affect a replacement job. Body limit: 1024 bytes. 202 is not terminal completion.

202.description: Worker confirmed stop intent, or retained accepted stop replay; not proof the task has stopped.

503.description: Worker unavailable or stop acknowledgement unconfirmed; retained stop projection may have outcome_known=false.

get.description: Worker-authoritative create/update/stop query, or bounded controller history. A 200 response can have outcome_known=false, state=unknown, reason=operation_outcome_unknown and last_observed after unconfirmed worker loss. Cached pending never proves not_written. See component-updates.md.

post.summary: Typed sparse watermark update with worker CAS and caller operation ID
post.description: 8192-byte envelope. Matching original intent replays before closing/CAS/budget checks. Omitted fields retain desired; null, unknown/duplicate keys and policy fields are rejected. Prepare failure retains failed desired and previous effective. Per-output revisions, shared per-job create/update/stop ID domain. 256 update records/2MiB worker store plus reserved stop; completed results retained at least 30 minutes, referenced records pinned. One outstanding update/query RPC, 2s acknowledgement wait. Bounded memory, not a durable journal.

202.description: Worker accepted or matching operation active.

503.description: Worker unavailable/recovering or update outcome unconfirmed; a cached operation may be returned. Inspect outcome_known and reuse the original ID.

get.description: HTTP event-loop liveness, independent of media output.

200.description: Structured controller/control decision; not proof of media progress or reserved capacity.

get.description: Reliable ownership/control management. Healthy busy remains ready; recovery/unavailable/stale control closes readiness. No new automatic kill threshold.

200.description: Structured controller/control decision; not proof of media progress or reserved capacity.

503.description: Control readiness/admission closed, with explicit reason.

get.description: New creation eligibility; busy/recovery/retention/worker/backoff reasons are distinct from readiness.

200.description: Structured controller/control decision; not proof of media progress or reserved capacity.

503.description: Control readiness/admission closed, with explicit reason.

get.summary: Controller health, build capabilities and worker pool

200.description: Controller is reachable; inspect status and pool separately from media progress.

get.summary: Current job or last job; idle before any job

post.summary: Start the single media job asynchronously

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: HTTP-attempt correlation, not a business retry key. Missing values receive a random 128-bit ID; invalid values return 400.

202.description: Initial worker ACK returns JobStatus; retained accepted creation retry returns OperationResult.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ranges or cross-field combination.

413.description: Empty body or request body exceeds 16384 bytes. Libevent may return text/html.

503.description: Unavailable/recovering or unconfirmed acceptance. A retained creation may return its operation projection; do not assume rejection or use a new ID.

post.description: Request body limit: 16384 bytes. Retained identical intent is finite in-memory replay, not durable/exactly-once execution.

post.summary: Prepare and atomically replace the single watermark
post.description: Full replacement. Revision must equal worker accepted_revision+1; initial revision=1. 202 acknowledges worker acceptance, not preparation/application. Poll watermark status. 2s ACK timeout returns 503 with uncertain outcome; inspect worker revision before retrying. Required cannot be disabled; startup.required immutable. Body 1..8192 bytes.

202.description: Worker accepted the legacy full replacement, not proof of applied/first_written.

409.description: Revision/policy/target conflict, pending ACK or worker rejection. A worker rejection uses watermark_rejected; local rejection uses error.

503.description: Worker unavailable, shutdown, or uncertain ACK timeout; inspect accepted revision.

post.summary: Request cancellation; poll until stopped or failed
post.description: Legacy adapter requires explicit job_id; optional operation_id enables retained retries. CLI resolves current once then binds that ID. 202 accepts controller stop intent; use the new targeted route for worker-ACK acceptance. In-flight reordered frames may be omitted. Body limit: 1024 bytes. 202 is not terminal completion.

202.description: Initial controller stop intent returns JobStatus; retained matching retry can return the stop operation projection. First acceptance does not wait for worker ACK.

503.description: Worker unavailable or stop acknowledgement unconfirmed; retained stop projection may have outcome_known=false.

Status.description: Asynchronous job snapshot. Worker fields can be absent until the first snapshot. Retains last job after completion. No-store.

Error.description: Application JSON error (400/404/405/409/413/429/500/503 as applicable). Unknown URI=404; legacy exact known URI with wrong method=405. Libevent or allocation failures may return HTML.

WatermarkPatch.description: Sparse typed fields; omission retains desired, null rejected. Startup/update/animation policies and encoder/output fields are immutable.

OperationResult.description: applied and first_written may identify different frames. first_written is local write/flush, not display. Unknown outcome retains last_observed and confirmed checkpoints; pending history is never presented as current execution. Create/stop projections may omit update-only fields (result_version, target, checkpoints, delivery, result_source and expiry). A create replay includes job_url, while the first accepted create returns JobStatus. State strings describe different operation kinds, not job terminal state.

result_version.description: Worker-store mutation sequence scoped to this job. Covers all result fields, including lease and retention changes after delivery. Controllers retain the entire greatest-version result despite message reordering.

JobConfig.description: UTF-8 strings must fit C buffers in bytes, exclude NUL. At most 32 keys; duplicates rejected before schema validation. min_threads<=max_threads. width/height are both zero/omitted or both positive even values. RTMP output requires flv; SRT requires mpegts. pace=true requires a local input. Encoder preset/profile must match the selected encoder; defaults are conditional. Merged input/output canvas area is <=4096*2160 pixels (live-4k-v1), not 8192*8192. JSON Schema does not enforce all conditional inheritance, UTF-8 byte limits, unique destinations/IDs, canvas products, encoder compatibility or cross-output thread sums; the C validator remains authoritative. Branch budgets in a one-element outputs array are accepted but the direct execution path does not create a branch FIFO or enable branch lag/inflight policy.

input.description: Local path or enabled FFmpeg input URL; maximum 2047 bytes. Video H.264/HEVC only.

output.description: New local path (exclusive create), or udp://, tcp://, rtmp://, srt://, http:// URL. Parent directory must exist; maximum 2047 bytes.

encoder_preset.description: x264 defaults to veryfast; VVenC defaults to faster and only accepts faster/fast/medium/slow/slower.

encoder_profile.description: x264 only default. VVenC defaults to live_3b_2s, also accepts reference/live_3b_2s_no_mctf. Live profiles use a PTS-anchored 2s CRA grid, full 3B groups and shorter boundary/tail groups.

bitrate.description: Target video bits per second in bitrate mode. Must be omitted in native CQF mode.

rate_control.description: bitrate is the default. cqf uses native capped QP/QPA with required maxrate. constrained_crf is an experimental direct-output quality anchor plus causal dual-budget feedback; requires follow_source, output_fps and future guard, excludes qp/bitrate; see vvenc.md.

qp.description: Only accepted with rate_control=cqf; QPA is enabled.

maxrate.description: Required only for cqf. Native approximate bitrate cap in bits/s, not a strict wire-rate bound.

output_fps.description: Optional integer decimation after full decode. Known input rate must be an exact integer multiple (divisor <=256); unsupported ratios fail after media rate resolution. Source PTS and protected first/I/SEI pictures are preserved, so this is not a general hard-CFR guarantee.

budget_slots.description: Adaptive decoder budget, not an overall CPU quota.

queue_capacity.description: Async decoder queue; independent from reader and mux queues.

fps.description: Used only when av_guess_frame_rate is unavailable. Input rational rate drives shared queue work; optional output_fps independently adjusts selected output and encoder/RC hints. Source PTS are preserved. See video-rate.md.

network_trace.description: Opt-in plain RTMP first media-message TCP recv to actual mux/flush provenance. Forces complete video/input-packet trace through the bounded logger; unsupported or missing origin fails. Not wire or display latency.

rtmp_tcp_nodelay.description: Apply TCP_NODELAY to this job's applicable plain RTMP input/output sockets. Other protocols are unaffected. The benchmark applies the same option to its source/capture peers.

encoder_max_future_frames.description: Single direct live VVenC CQF output only. 0 disables; 1..4 enables bounded pending-AU progress and rejects an AU released with more than this number of submitted newer encoding pictures. Not an encoder CPU deadline.

frame_log_every.description: Detail sampling only; metrics still count every written video frame. I/key/slow frames override sampling.

audio_copy.description: Bounded AAC/MP3 passthrough for FLV/TS; MP4 always video-only. No audio encoding.

mux_wait_ms.description: FLV/TS monotonic wall interleaving wait; polled every 10ms. Excludes encode, scheduling stalls and blocking network I/O.

outputs.description: One logical output retains the direct execution path and defaults id to main; arrays with two to four entries require explicit unique ids. Status omits outputs for a single logical output. Runtime destinations, encoders, dimensions and output membership are immutable.

crf.description: Experimental constrained CRF quality anchor, not x264/x265 CRF scale; direct live VVenC only.

source_rate_limit.description: constrained_crf only: causal past 1s completed input video rate budget; requires network_trace.

decoder_early_output.description: Initialization-only codec output override, independent of async frontend/pump. Omitted preserves old codec defaults (HEVC enabled, H264 disabled). false selects original DPB policy; true enables only proven eligible paths. H264 automatic eligibility requires progressive CFR NAL-HRD and picture-timing SEI; ordinary streams without this proof fall back. The library also has a separate explicit verified-input contract assertion, never supplied by this service for arbitrary input. No hot switching.

decoder_pump.description: Direct output only: dedicated owner of async decode frontend with one bounded dispatch slot; requires decoder_async=true. This is not the async backend switch.

codec_trace.description: Opt-in Linux native HEVC decoder and live VVenC per-picture phase/CPU telemetry; direct output and future guard required; forces complete traces. Diagnostic overhead must be measured separately.

encoder_bit_depth.description: VVenC internal encoding and bitstream precision. Input/filter stays yuv420p10le in a 16-bit container; 8 does not enable byte-storage or 8-bit SIMD kernels. Only libvvenc.

encoder_input_bit_depth.description: Explicit VVenC input/filter sample precision. 8 uses read-only packed byte planes and requires encoder_bit_depth=8, live CQF and encoder_max_future_frames. Internal Pel and residual buffers still use 16-bit storage. Direct output only with current guard.

encoder_native8_reference.description: Experimental byte reference buffers and integer ME SIMD; direct guarded live CQF, internal 8-bit only. Fractional prediction and residuals retain signed working precision.

decoder_async.description: Initialization-only decoder backend. true uses the existing asynchronous owner; false uses synchronous send/receive on the pipeline owner. Independent of decoder_early_output. decoder_pump requires true. Synchronous calls may block for decoding.

decoder_auto_threads.description: Async-only pressure-based dispatch/budget control. false keeps fixed max_threads for controlled comparisons. Ignored when decoder_async=false; no async budget is created there. Omission preserves the existing automatic async default.

OutputConfig.description: Fixed startup branch. Unique ASCII id and destination. Other media fields inherit top-level defaults; top-level output/watermark are forbidden with outputs. Width/height pair and area <=4096*2160; zero uses first decoded canvas then freezes it. Encoder threads across branches sum <=16. Decoder is shared. Temporary queue fullness uses one shared 100ms pressure window after offering to all healthy branches; later healthy items can wait during that window. Only a timely drain strictly below all half-water marks resets it (capacity 1/2 must empty). Sustained pressure or I/O deadline fails only this branch; no destination reopen or compressed-packet dropping. Producer retains at most one pending item per branch outside queue metrics, each within single-item byte/media limits; video_items (alias queue_items) and audio_packets independently bound one FIFO; queue plus pending conservatively <=video_items+audio_packets+1, 2*queue_bytes and 2*queue_media_ms. queue_media_ms charges nominal video work duration, not PTS gaps. inflight_bytes reserves retained source plus encoder-input buffers through actual mux, max 128 frames; not an RSS bound. Codec internals, watermark assets/canvases and bounded mux/deferred audio have separate caps. Branch FIFO/lag/inflight controls apply to two-to-four owners; a single logical output remains on the direct path. Its io_timeout_ms still controls output I/O.

rate_control.description: Fixed output branches support existing bitrate/native CQF; experimental constrained_crf requires a direct root output.

queue_items.description: Compatibility spelling of video_items; cannot be combined with video_items. Audio has its own quota.

SeiPolicy.description: Explicit opaque type/payload preservation; uuid aliases numeric type 5 without UUID layout validation. Alias/numeric duplicates are rejected. Omission or an empty list disables preservation. Root list is inherited by each output; branch sei replaces the whole list. Selected pictures are protected from overload dropping. H.264/HEVC input to H.264/VVC output is reframed with unchanged type and payload. Complete single-picture single-layer AUs only; up to 64 selected messages and 65536 payload bytes per input AU across the output union. Overflow, malformed outer framing, unsupported AU association or missing decoded mapping fails explicitly. No payload semantics, HDR/geometry adjustment or hot updates. See sei.md.

VideoRate.description: Resolved startup nominal rational rate; source PTS cadence is unchanged. See video-rate.md.

OutputStatus.description: Private output owner summary; all per-frame latency metrics end at actual local write/flush. output_id also labels trace and unconditional startup checkpoints. On teardown queued/inflight counters return to zero.

sei_extracted.description: Selected messages received by this output owner.

sei_written.description: Selected source messages after successful local write/flush.

sei_protected_frames.description: Pictures protected because they carry selected source SEI.

first_frame_checkpoints.description: Unconditional first-video/first-output-key checkpoints retained for controller recovery; not display acknowledgements.

queued_work_us.description: Alias of queue_media_us: nominal retained processing work, not PTS span.

queue_rejected_attempts.description: Admission attempts including retries, not dropped media packets.

TimestampPolicy.description: Omission preserves legacy best-effort/synthetic behavior. source_all rejects missing/duplicate/backward display PTS, permits source gaps and identifiable clock wrap; output quantization must remain monotonic. No I-anchor retiming or dirty timestamp repair.

IntraPolicy.description: Requires timestamps.mode=source_all. VVenC reference profile is rejected. Source I matches decoded picture type, not packet key. Startup remains IDR; later requested I are ordinary I, with actual encoder type confirmation. Missing optional constraints use the single accepted behavior below.

FrameSelection.description: Omission keeps all decoded pictures. live_drop_only requires explicit source_all and intra policies; first/source-I/due-I pictures are protected. No default overload thresholds.

Overload.description: Server also checks strictly increasing enter_ms and keep_one_in, positive recover_below_ms below level 1, and max_continuous_degraded_ms greater than recover_sustain_ms. Recovery must complete strictly before the continuous degraded deadline; exhaustion wins equality, including late polls. Worker polls about every 50ms independently of mux/control connection. No hard realtime guarantee across an uninterruptible codec call. Inflight metadata cap is 512; overflow fails.

uri.description: Local regular path or HTTP/HTTPS URI; byte limit is 2047. Only built-in JPEG/PNG/GIF decoders.

Watermark.description: Single SDR watermark. Enabled requires resource.uri. startup.required requires enabled and is immutable within a job; full replacement must repeat true for required jobs. Fixed 8MiB encoded, 2097152 source pixels, 128 frames, 60s animation, 64MiB raw per generation, two generations. Canvas <=4096x2160. Reject zero-delay animated GIF, APNG, HDR and unsupported PNG profiles/compressed ancillary metadata. See watermark.md.

output_id.description: Required for multiple outputs; optional for direct output but must match its logical id. Revision belongs to the selected output.

WatermarkUpdate.description: Legacy full replacement. Explicit job_id; output_id required for multiple owners, optional but matching for a direct logical output.

video_compatible.description: Only meaningful when video_properties_known is true. An incompatible optional pre-first-frame enable fails its revision while keeping the initial disabled stream.

resource_observation.description: Bounded controller FD and mounted cgroup-root observation, not worker RSS or admission capacity.

JobStatus.description: Extensible snapshot; see service.md, operations.md and live-mux.md for remaining telemetry. Non-required media fields are absent before the first worker snapshot. Latencies end at local mux/AVIO completion, not peer display.

sei_types.description: Single-output selection, or union of output selections.

sei_extracted.description: Selected source messages extracted once across the output union.

sei_written.description: Messages successfully written locally; sum across outputs when multiple.

sei_protected_frames.description: Pictures protected by selected SEI; sum across outputs when multiple.

outputs.description: Only present for two-to-four branch owners; single logical output uses root telemetry.

frames_decoded.description: Shared input decoded once, not sum of renditions.

frames_filtered.description: Sum of output submissions for multi-output.

bytes_out.description: All media AVIO bytes; not wire bytes.

startup.description: Checkpoints from complete HTTP handler entry; first-output fields null until written.

first_frame_checkpoints.description: Unconditional first-video/first-output-key checkpoints retained for controller recovery; not display acknowledgements.

OutputFinalize.description: Monotonic output-owner finalize timestamps; zero means not observed. Existing media error wins. After media success without stop, promote first error in trailer/flush/close order. Stop keeps its classification while recording cleanup errors. Independent of peer delivery or fsync.

MediaProgress.description: Ages are measured at the worker snapshot sample, not at the later HTTP response. Encoded precedes hooks; written follows successful mux/AVIO flush. No source-to-screen or wire timing.

SnapshotFreshness.description: Controller receipt freshness does not refresh media observations; inactive retained snapshots may age.

EffectiveResourceLimits.description: Application retained-data/profile bounds, not total process RSS or measured throughput.

RequestId.description: Per HTTP attempt; caller X-Request-ID when valid, otherwise generated. Not an operation ID.

NoStore.description: Application JSON responses are not cacheable.
